bounded_materialization.normalization_policy: PROPOSED_ONLY: parse XML; retain ns=0 non-redirect current revision text; strict UTF-8/newline normalization; canonical JSONL; no partial-page truncation

proposed_bound_if_retested.determinism: pin dump date, file, official checksum/index boundary, page_id, revision_id, revision_timestamp, raw SHA-256 and normalized SHA-256
proposed_bound_if_retested.selection: first multistream block (100 pages) from the first official pages-articles multistream shard, then ns=0/non-redirect filtering

required_if_retested: exact normalized SHA-256 dedup against live external registry
contamination check against reserved evaluation/final-test material without consuming reserved content into training

language_verification.required_if_retested: incumbent English LID must pass on every retained record

privacy.source_level_risk: Wikipedia may contain biographies and other public personal data; project PII/privacy screening remains mandatory on any future retained bytes.

project_policy_compatibility.incumbent_block_reason: CC-BY-SA source; project has no approved ShareAlike compliance policy for training artifacts/model outputs.

evaluation.reason: Evaluation/final-test/selection material is outside this authority and must remain firewalled.

model_training.reason: Upstream reuse rights are broad, but current project policy explicitly withholds model-training admission until ShareAlike compliance for training artifacts/model outputs is approved.

redistribution.reason: No project-compliant attribution/ShareAlike redistribution policy and no materialized snapshot authority.

source_level_notes: Wikipedia is heterogeneous and one bounded slice cannot establish broad English representativeness.
Wikitext/templates/redirects require deterministic filtering before quality claims.

retest_conditions: Owner-approved or terminal project policy explicitly resolves CC BY-SA attribution/ShareAlike obligations for training artifacts and model-output/weight distribution claims.
Bounded immutable bytes are materialized from the pinned dump/revisions and raw/normalized SHA-256 are retained.
English LID, quality, privacy/PII, exact/near dedup and contamination gates pass.
Live registry is refreshed again and no conflicting terminal Wikipedia authority exists.

attribution_obligations: credit authors via article/revision-history URL, equivalent stable copy, or author list
identify CC BY-SA 4.0 and provide license link/copy
preserve additional attribution notices for imported text when applicable
rights.license_scope: Wikipedia community text; page-specific/imported-text exceptions and additional attribution requirements may apply
rights.sharealike_obligation: If adapted material is shared, contributions must be distributed under CC BY-SA 4.0 or compatible terms as applicable.
rights.warranty_boundary: License does not resolve privacy, publicity, moral rights, fair-use exceptions, or every third-party right.

authoritative_dump.current_revision_semantics: pages-articles current revisions at dump time
